comment: Target ESI compatibility date 2026-11-19 and generate from the matching schema version. Removes the static /universe/* data routes, /sovereignty/map, /sovereignty/structures, and GET /route (replaced by postRoute); adds 39 new endpoints. Renames methods with leftover ID tokens or doubled/plural parents, e.g. getCharacterMailMailId -> getCharacterMailMessage, getKillmailKillmailHash -> getKillmail, getMarketsGroupsMarketGroupId -> getMarketsGroup, getCorporationCorporationMiningExtractions -> getCorporationMiningExtractions, getCorporationWalletsDivisionJournal -> getCorporationWalletJournal.
